title: The Builder typechecks, and the build enforces it
description: Found by F-33 (MS-2026-0005). vite build never typechecks, and a syntax error in a dead file made tsc skip type checking entirely. With it removed, tsc reports 384 errors across the Builder (knowledge 94, genesis 37, knowledge-v3 25, runtime 14, executive 7, others). The main cause: @types/react and @types/react-dom are not installed, so every component prop with key fails and the React namespace is missing; vite-env.d.ts sits outside the included src, so image imports have no types.
objective: npm run build fails on a Builder type error, and the Builder has none.
risks: The count after the React types are installed is not known yet; npm was not reachable from Claude's environment to measure it.
Some errors may be real defects, not just missing types.
